# DivergingBarChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasDivergingBarChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasDivergingBarChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasDivergingBarChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasDivergingBarChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Values either side of a centre: likert scales, demographics

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasDivergingBarChart> CreateDivergingBarChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasDivergingBarChart> CreatePopulationPyramid( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const std::vector<std::string>& rowLabels, const std::vector<DivergingCategory>& categories);

```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasDivergingBarChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

Methods: `AddCategoryValue`

### enum `DivergingChartStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PopulationPyramid` | Symmetric bars extending from center (like the image) |
| `TornadoChart` | Single bars with positive/negative values |
| `LikertScale` | Stacked segments diverging from center |
| `OpposingBars` | Two separate bars meeting at center |

| `isPositive` | `bool isPositive` | True if on right/positive side, false if on left/negative side |
